codeReview.summary: APP-001 implementation correctly adds the Boot to First ELF Exec test case with proper Meson wiring, harness support, and artifact generation. The code follows existing patterns from 02b-harness-capability cases and produces all required artifacts as specified in expected.yaml.

issues.description: Milestone extraction relies on log pattern matching which may be brittle if log format changes. The comment at line 1735 acknowledges this with 'This is because the log capture window may miss the exact moment.' Consider making milestone detection more robust or documented as a known limitation.
Timestamp generation uses order * 100 for synthetic timestamps. This is acceptable for ordering but loses actual timing information. Consider capturing real timestamps from log entries if available.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Worker correctly followed the expected.yaml pattern for defining artifact expectations. This is a good pattern that should be maintained for all test cases.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Phase name determination logic in ios_app_harness.c main() correctly routes APP-001 through APP-005 to '02c-ios-app-runtime-entry' phase. This hardcoded mapping approach is clear and explicit.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: ios_app_harness.c lines 2175-2180: const char *phase_name determined based on case_type, with explicit check for CASE_APP_001 through CASE_APP_005.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Worker followed test-worker skill procedure correctly. All verification steps align with skill requirements: Meson wiring, harness extension, artifact generation, and test execution.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Handoff shows skillFeedback.followedProcedure: true with no deviations. Verification commands match skill example pattern.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The milestone extraction pattern (app_boot_milestones array with name/log_pattern/order) is a reusable abstraction that should be documented for future APP case implementations.

summary: APP-001 implementation is solid and follows all repository conventions. The test case correctly validates boot to first ELF exec entry with proper Meson wiring, harness support for the new case type, and generation of all required artifacts (sim_launch.json, boot_milestones.json, first_elf_exec.json, report.json).
